|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploys -2 on Rogue 1. [Pilot] 3. When piloting Rogue 1, adds 2 to maneuver and draws two battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Once during each of your control phases, may ▲ any speeder or card with 'T-47' in its game text.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Commander Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Rogue 1, it is maneuver +2 and Luke draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During your control phase, may take a speeder or a card with “T-47” in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' “Deploys -2 on Rogue 1. [Pilot] 3. When” → “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While”; “adds 2 to” → “it is”; added “+2”; added “Luke”; “not able” → “unable”; “Once during each of” → “During”; “phases,” → “phase,”; “▲ any” → “take a”; added “a”; “'T-47'” → ““T-47””; removed “its”; “text.” → “text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.”.
